We need to trace through the program.

N=5, M=6, K=328.
Edges:
e1: 1-2, w=99
e2: 1-3, w=102
e3: 2-3, w=86
e4: 2-4, w=94
e5: 2-5, w=95
e6: 3-4, w=81

We need spanning trees with 4 edges, connected (spanning all 5 nodes). Compute total weight mod 328, minimize. Note min_cost starts at K=328, but any cost < 328 will replace it (cost is total % 328, so at most 327). Since a spanning tree exists (e.g., e1,e3,e4,e5: 1-2,2-3,2-4,2-5), min_cost will be min over spanning trees of sum mod 328.

We want minimum sum of 4 edges forming spanning tree. Let's enumerate spanning trees.

Nodes 1..5. Edge 2-5 is the only edge to node 5, so must include e5 (w=95). Then remaining 3 edges must connect {1,2,3,4} using edges e1(1-2,99), e2(1-3,102), e3(2-3,86), e6(3-4,81), plus e4(2-4,94). Need spanning tree on 4 nodes with 3 edges.

Possible trees on nodes 1,2,3,4 using these edges:
Edges available: 12,13,23,24,34.

Spanning trees (3 edges, connected, acyclic) on K4: 16 total. Let's enumerate subsets of 3 edges from {12,13,23,24,34} that form a tree.

Subsets:
{12,13,23}: triangle, not tree.
{12,13,24}: connects 1-2,1-3,2-4 → tree. Sum=99+102+94=295. Total with 95 = 390.
{12,13,34}: 1-2,1-3,3-4 → tree. Sum=99+102+81=282. Total 377.
{12,23,24}: 1-2,2-3,2-4 → tree (star at 2). Sum=99+86+94=279. Total 374.
{12,23,34}: 1-2,2-3,3-4 → path. Sum=99+86+81=266. Total 361.
{12,24,34}: 1-2,2-4,3-4 → tree. Sum=99+94+81=274. Total 369.
{13,23,24}: 1-3,2-3,2-4 → tree. Sum=102+86+94=282. Total 377.
{13,23,34}: triangle 1-3,2-3,3-4 → tree? 1-3,2-3,3-4: star at 3. Sum=102+86+81=269. Total 364.
{13,24,34}: 1-3,2-4,3-4 → connects 1-3-4-2 → tree. Sum=102+94+81=277. Total 372.
{23,24,34}: triangle 2-3,2-4,3-4 → cycle, not tree.
{12,13,23} done. Also {12,13,24} done. {12,13,34} done. {12,23,24}, {12,23,34}, {12,24,34}, {13,23,24}, {13,23,34}, {13,24,34}, {23,24,34}. Also {12,13, ... } we covered. {12,24,...} etc. All 10 combos: {12,13,23},{12,13,24},{12,13,34},{12,23,24},{12,23,34},{12,24,34},{13,23,24},{13,23,34},{13,24,34},{23,24,34}. Trees: 8 of them (excluding two triangles).

Totals: 390, 377, 374, 361, 369, 377, 364, 372.

Min total = 361 → mod 328 = 33.

Check: 361 % 328 = 33. 390%328=62, 377%328=49, 374%328=46, 369%328=41, 364%328=36, 372%328=44.

Min cost = 33.

Also note: connected check with union-find — connected means spanning all N nodes; 4 successful unions on 5 nodes means spanning tree indeed.

Output: 33.
